high_risk_checks.test: Do not equate a product conditioned on nonoverlap with exactly independent one-particle marginals. Distinguish fixed-N probability marginals from grand canonical rescaled factorial correlations. Preserve partition function, 1/N!, nonoverlap indicator, and correlation scaling.

high_risk_checks.topic: Boltzmann-Grad, dilute fraction and joint parameter restrictions
high_risk_checks.test: N epsilon^(d-1) is inverse Knudsen scale; occupied-volume scale is N epsilon^d. In the torus theorem, max(1,alpha) max(1,A) max(1,t_fin) must be much smaller than sqrt(log|log epsilon|). Bounds on eta and t_fin cannot be made independent when both vary.

high_risk_checks.topic: From particles to fluid: hypotheses and error composition
high_risk_checks.test: Do not transfer epsilon^theta particle-to-Boltzmann error to the Euler Maxwellian without a separate hydrodynamic term. The cited compressible statement uses prepared Hilbert expansion data and O(delta) error; the incompressible statement uses prepared small perturbations, physical time delta^-1 T_fin and O(delta^(3/2)) error. Distinguish velocity from momentum density rho*u.

high_risk_checks.topic: Wave Fourier, Laplacian and kinetic-time constants
high_risk_checks.test: On [0,L]^d, k in L^-1 Z^d requires exp(2pi i k.x). WAVE-v2 uses normalized Laplacian (2pi)^-1 sum partial_j^2 and T_kin=(2 alpha^2)^-1; the survey suppresses constants and writes alpha^-2. Do not combine incompatible exact conventions. State E|g_k|^2=1 and circular complex Gaussian convention.

high_risk_checks.topic: Wave theorem quantifiers and existence event
high_risk_checks.test: d>=3, fixed gamma in (0,1), nonnegative Schwartz spectrum, fixed tau_* strictly before maximal WKE time; the microscopic smooth solution has overwhelming probability, with expectation interpreted on its existence event. Theta depends on d,gamma; sufficiently large L depends on chosen data and time. Global boundedness is needed for the stated loglog time extension. No automatic endpoint gamma=1 or d=2 extension.

high_risk_checks.topic: Chaos, repeated modes and higher cumulants
high_risk_checks.test: Mode factorization requires distinct modes and controlled orders; repeated complex Gaussian modes have factorial Wick multiplicities. Gauge/translation selection rules require invariance of the initial law as well as dynamics. Particle E_H relative to f^A is not the ordinary joint partition cumulant.

The obstruction concerns a time-reversal-invariant norm-only sufficient induction hypothesis. It does not say cumulants cannot be small in a norm, since their smallness is proved a posteriori from structural information. At Fourier level physical conjugation also reflects k.

Distinguish dominant couples from all regular couples. Diverging diagrams require grouped cancellation before absolute bounds. Particle integral formulas need decay and localization; a compact toy model is not a full proof of the research bound. Cutting counts alone do not prove full cumulant estimates without truncation and summation.

Recompute collision involution, momentum/energy, entropy sign with positive-part kernel, Maxwellian moments, cumulant inversion, graph inclusion-exclusion over unordered pairs, and factorial-vs-power estimate. Do not label Penrose tree regrouping or the full cutting algorithm as proved from inclusion-exclusion alone.

findings.title: The displayed lattice-ball quantity is not a norm in high dimension
